result.description:
Career Opportunity: Rehabilitation Consultant (Physiotherapy or Exercise Physiology)

 A premier national occupational rehabilitation provider is seeking a driven and energetic Physiotherapist or Exercise Physiologist to join their multidisciplinary team in Kotara, NSW. Operating within a private corporate health environment, this role focuses on supporting individuals through tailored injury prevention, workplace rehabilitation, and physical supports. This full-time, permanent position is available for an immediate start in April 2026, offering the successful candidate the autonomy to manage their own schedule while benefiting from the resources and stability of a global health network. 

 The successful practitioner will provide essential rehabilitation services to clients with a range of physical and psychological conditions. Key responsibilities include comprehensive case management, the application of clinical knowledge to improve return-to-work outcomes, and the implementation of injury prevention programs. The consultant will conduct a variety of clinical assessments—including initial, workplace, and vocational reviews—across diverse schemes such as Workers Compensation, Comcare, and the Department of Veteran's Affairs. To ensure a focus on high-quality care, consultants are supported by Rehabilitation Assistants who handle administrative tasks, keeping caseloads manageable and purposeful. 

 Remuneration for this role is highly competitive, featuring innovative incentive and bonus schemes designed to reward high achievers. The organization is committed to professional growth, offering a "promote from within" culture and a comprehensive onboarding program. New graduates are encouraged to apply, with a hands-on approach to learning and long-term career pathways available across the wider medical group. Benefits are extensive, including a Fitness Passport, novated leasing, salary packaging, discounted health insurance, and travel perks, alongside a robust health and wellness program and various Diversity and Inclusion committees. 

 To be considered for this opportunity, candidates must hold a tertiary qualification in Physiotherapy (AHPRA registered) or Exercise Physiology (ESSA accredited). The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a compassionate approach to client care, and strong time-management abilities. A current NSW Driver’s License and access to a personal vehicle with comprehensive insurance are essential requirements for this role. This is a unique chance to join a collaborative and fun team dedicated to making a positive difference in the community through bold ideas and meaningful connections.   Apply Now
